description.content: Lending-grade ClearAVM and Rental AVM automated valuations via the Property Analytics API. Endpoint paths are documented in Clear Capital's gated developer portal and are not reproduced here.

Property characteristics, market trends, and sales/listing/owner/tax history via the Property Analytics API. Endpoint paths are documented in Clear Capital's gated developer portal and are not reproduced here.
Comparable sales and rentals ranked by ClearRank via the Property Analytics API. Endpoint paths are documented in Clear Capital's gated developer portal and are not reproduced here.

Ordering and fulfillment of Hybrid/Desktop appraisal, BPO, CDA, and UDC via the Property Valuation API. Endpoint paths are documented in Clear Capital's gated developer portal and are not reproduced here.

Clear Capital valuation and property data REST APIs (Property Analytics API and Property Valuation API). Access is sales-led and gated; exact endpoint paths and schemas live in the developer portal at docs.api.clearcapital.com and are not reproduced here to avoid fabrication. Folders represent documented product areas.
